tools.name: reminder_set
tools.description:
Set a deterministic reminder that fires at a future time or after N turns, injecting your reminder text into context as a <system-reminder> block.

**When to use:** When you want to remember to do something later — e.g. 'don't forget to file a ticket', 'review the plan after 5 turns', 'check status at 3pm'.

**Trigger shapes (v1):**
- Time-based: `{"type":"time","at":"<RFC3339>"}` — fires when the clock reaches the given time.
- Turn-count: `{"type":"turn_count","n":5}` — fires N turns after this call.

**Scope (D1, CW-20260428-0014):**
- `turn`: fires within the same turn it was created in.
- `session` (default): fires only in the originating session.
- `project`: fires in any session of the same project; requires project_id (resolved from the current session's project when omitted).

**When NOT to use:** Do not use for calendar events, cross-system notifications, or anything requiring an LLM to decide when to fire — triggers are always deterministic in v1.

**Reminder display:** When a reminder fires, its text is injected as `<system-reminder>` into the next turn's context and surfaced in the I1 dev-mode inspector. There is no UI toast in v1.

**Output shape:** `{reminder_id, scope, status: 'set', trigger}`.

project_id.description: Project ID — required when scope=project. Auto-resolved from the current session's project when omitted.

text.description: The reminder text to inject when the trigger fires.

n.description: Number of turns to wait (for type=turn_count)

tools.name: context_pin
tools.description:
Pin content so the system keeps it in context across turns (session scope) or across sessions in a project (project scope). Pinned content rides in the SlotUserContext budget and is visible in the bottom drawer Pins tab.

**When to use:** When you want to keep a piece of context visible throughout the conversation or across sessions — e.g. a key decision, a reference snippet, a current task description.

**Scopes (D1, CW-20260428-0014):**
- `turn`: ephemeral, cleared after the current turn (not stored in DB).
- `session` (default): survives compaction, cleared at session end.
- `project`: persists for the project; surfaces in any session of the same project. Requires project_id (resolved from the current session's project when omitted).

**Budget:** Pinned content shares the 2000-token SlotUserContext budget. Oldest pins truncate first when over budget. Keep pins thin.

**Output shape:** `{pin_id, scope, status: 'pinned'}`.

content.description: Content to pin. Keep thin — shares the 2000-token SlotUserContext budget.

project_id.description: Project ID — required when scope=project. Auto-resolved from the current session's project when omitted.

tools.name: context_unpin
tools.description:
Remove a pinned item by ID, freeing its context budget.

**When to use:** When pinned content is no longer needed — after the user acknowledges it, after the task it describes is complete, or when the budget needs freeing.

**Required context:** pin_id from a prior context_pin call.

**Output shape:** `{pin_id, status: 'unpinned'}`.

pin_id.description: Pin ID to remove (from prior context_pin call).
